env_files.role: Eight-page archived baseline and release-governance guide covering approval quorum, code fallback, catalog validation, business-day rollout arithmetic, regional overlays, entitlement filtering, package/component totals, and public handoff rules
Live operational workbook with target records interleaved across unrelated release activity and plausible invalid alternatives

design_notes: The task dimension and evaluation mode are unchanged; difficulty is increased through event-state resolution, approval-quorum joins, catalog fallback, feature validation, business-day arithmetic, regional overlays, entitlement filtering, and package-component calculations.
The newest eligible-looking change is intentionally wrong for several code fields; the agent must continue through ranked candidates after catalog validation failure.
Target rows are distributed across more than 5,500 operational records without answer, gold, final, use_this, should_exclude, or scoring columns.
Grounded VQAs are rational fact and consistency checks; visual quality remains isolated in the unchanged single visual VQA.
